QuestInfo.name: [Repeatable] Galacto-Drill Goes Boom
QuestInfo.0: The alien matter-cloners are making new #b#o9400802##k robots faster than you can break them! #b#p9201050##k proposes a new plan.
QuestInfo.1: The mayor thinks that destroying 300 of the #b#o9400802##k robots will cause the aliens to run out of materials. He's offered you a #b#i3062220# #t3062220:##k, a B-Rank Nebulite, that he's really in love with.
QuestInfo.2: You destroyed the #b#o9400802##k 300 times! That #b#i3062220# #t3062220:##k, the B-Rank Nebulite, is yours!

0.0:
Well, the aliens are producing too many #b#o9400802##k for us to do anything about. They didn't even notice all the ones you took down. They even put up a funny poster at their work-site about it! It was very well-drawn and quite amusing.

But you're not going to stand for that, are you? You know what you should do? You should go beat up the guys who made that machine!

yes.0: Please complete [Repeatable] The Alien Mainframe Quest 300 times. I'm sure that will set them back! If you do it, I'll give you #b#i3062220# #t3062220:##k, the B-Rank Nebulite I've been holding for my ring-bling.

no.0: We must protect #b#m600000000##k from the alien invasion... oh my goodness, I cannot stop thinking about that poster. It looked SO much like you!

yes.0: Oh snap! You took down the #o9400802#?! That's amazing. You are amazing! Today is amazing!
yes.1: Too bad about that matter-cloner they have, though! The #b#o9400802##k you took down is just going to get remade later. Bummer, huh? But maybe you bought us some time!
yes.2: If you want to shut down their operation, you're going to have to destroy that #b#o9400802##k a whoooole bunch of times. It may be an endless fight. That's why I'm pretty sure YOU are the perfect person to do it.
yes.3: Maybe you can help me launch a more... offensive plan! You're pretty good at being offensive, after all.
yes.4: Okay, talk to me when you're in the game!
